description: This file implements web service login functionality, including user authentication, token validation, and access key retrieval for vTiger CRM's web services.

methods.name: vtws_login
methods.description: Authenticates a user using username and password, validates token and access key, and returns user info if the account is active.

methods.name: vtws_getActiveToken
methods.description: Retrieves an active authentication token for a given user ID, if any.

methods.name: vtws_getUserAccessKey
methods.description: Retrieves the access key associated with a user ID.
